incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A multi-storey building is partially collapsed with debris scattered around. Dust is visible on the street, and the scene includes damaged infrastructure and trees in the background.

observations.description: A multi-storey building has suffered significant structural damage, with large sections of the facade and roof collapsed and debris piled on the ground.
No visible water or flooding in the immediate area.
A street pole is standing, and a portion of a green-painted building is visible on the left. A white sack is in the foreground.
A tree is visible in the background, and some greenery is visible among the debris.
No clear vehicles visible in the image.
No clearly identifiable people in the image. No visible individuals are in immediate danger or within the debris.

inconsistencies: Report says 'some residents may still be inside' but image does not show any visible people or signs of active rescue efforts.
not_determinable: Exact scale or distance of the collapse
Water depth or presence of floodwater
Whether the building is five-storey (as reported)
